desc: Six-shooters, lever guns, trap door rifles...whatever your nostalgic flavor may be, Fiocchi’s Cowboy Action ammo is your steadfast range companion. Exuding the same Old-World craftsmanship that Fiocchi has maintained since these firearms were in daily use across the American West, our smooth-shooting Cowboy Action cartridges feature the highest-quality smokeless powder, coated lead bullets to minimize fouling, and non-corrosive primers to keep your original or classic-style firearms in the game and on target.
